_provenance: Candidate corpus for lane 68-c rounds B/C. Round A (deepseek-v4-pro, receipts/call-02-round-a-deepseek.receipt.json) hit its completion-token cap (finish=length: 5789 reasoning + 211 visible tokens) after formatting 1.5 of its 9 planned primitives. The full plan was mined VERBATIM from the same receipted call's reasoning_content (receipts/round-a-deepseek.reasoning.md) and grammaticized minimally by lane 68-c; every definition below is the model's own wording from that trace, lightly edited for sentence form. Source field records origin per primitive. Judges advise; ledgers decide.

p1.name: Flow Calculus
p1.definition: A registered set of operations over quilt-chrono ledgers — diff(cell, dimension, window), integrate(flow, t1, t2), lag(a, b) — computed as pure reductions over append-only flow entries. Each operation emits a new DERIVED cell whose value is the integral/derivative quantity, not a stored event.
p1.unlocks: Operators gain warmth velocity and accumulated urgency as first-class objects, like d/dt made rate-of-change an object; they can intervene on acceleration or accumulated drift, not just thresholds.
p1.grows_from: quilt-chrono src/projection.js; the delta is from point-in-time views to closed derivative/integral/lead-lag operators over the time dimension.
p1.failure_mode: Naive discrete differencing amplifies ledger jitter and late-arriving entries; a derivative cell oscillates under small write noise and triggers false interventions.

p2.name: Moment Field
p2.definition: Interpolation over the named moment dimensions with gradients: from bucketed vector regions to a field the soft joints query continuously. Operators can compute policy gradients over a dimension (how a ruling changes as urgency moves), and the freezing test can promote continuous regions instead of only buckets.
p2.unlocks: The policy gradient as an object; freezing decisions on the shape of the field rather than the luck of bucket boundaries.
p2.grows_from: quilt-softjoints src/joint.js vector regions + quilt-storefront src/vector.js DIMS; delta: buckets -> field with interpolation and gradients.
p2.failure_mode: Without interpolation boundaries a continuous field selects too many or too few observations; gradients over sparse regions confabulate structure from noise.
p2.source: deepseek-v4-pro (final answer truncated mid-primitive; completed from its reasoning trace)

p3.name: Evidence Key
p3.definition: A deterministic, typed FACT projection carried alongside the emotional moment vector. Outcome branches (what happened) require evidence dimensions — receipt presence, amount, date; the emotional vector decides tone only. Region keys become compound: (fact-vector, tone-vector).
p3.unlocks: The storefront's freeze diagnosis becomes executable: facts decide outcomes, emotion decides tone; policy rulings become freezable because the region key can finally SEE the deciding feature.
p3.grows_from: quilt-storefront src/freeze.js + src/vector.js + the 67-c non-result (runs/adjustments.jsonl seq 18 v2-vector proposal); delta: emotion-only pre-vector -> compound fact+tone key.
p3.failure_mode: Fact extraction reintroduces a model call at freeze time (the thing freezing was meant to remove); naive regex fact keys overfit one domain's receipt vocabulary.

p4.name: Greeter Contract
p4.definition: A signed contract marking a cell as deliberately never decomposed: allowed inputs, a non-decomposition decision space, handoff triggers to a human, and a rule that the adjustment->cell compiler and freezing tests treat the cell as forbidden ground.
p4.unlocks: Greeter protection stops being a convention in notes fields and becomes an enforceable, auditable boundary the compiler cannot cross.
p4.grows_from: quilt-softjoints §5b greeter flag (notes-only today) + quilt-jev-toolkit signed checkpoints; delta: a notes flag -> a signed, enforced contract.
p4.failure_mode: Oversealing: the contract forbids the exact compile-time improvements runs legitimately discover; contracts drift from the live cell they protect.

p5.name: Causal Slice
p5.definition: A reconstructed provenance graph from a final decision back to the cells, facts, vectors, and ledger entries that produced it — the minimal replayable set that reproduces the output. Executable trace object, not just logs.
p5.unlocks: The debugger's question 'why did this cell fire?' becomes a first-class object you can hold, diff, and seal — like a stack trace that survives rewinds.
p5.grows_from: quilt-runbook src/mine.js WHY-mining + quilt-chrono ledger; delta: post-hoc log mining -> an executable slice object with replay guarantees.
p5.failure_mode: Slice reconstruction costs O(entire run) without index discipline; slices that include non-deterministic joints reproduce a DIFFERENT output than the one being explained.

p6.name: Invariant Monitor
p6.definition: Operators define pure functions over ledger projections that must hold (bool or numeric band); the runtime evaluates them on each flow entry and emits a sealed anomaly cell on violation — continuous assertions as objects, not ad-hoc checks.
p6.unlocks: Auditors get runtime-checked invariants ('refunds never exceed receipts', 'greeter never silent for > N turns') instead of post-hoc report reading.
p6.grows_from: quilt-chrono src/projection.js pure views + quilt-playtest CellEKG motion classification; delta: offline views -> live guards with sealed anomalies.
p6.failure_mode: Invariant spam: noisy monitors cry wolf until operators mute them; a monitor that reads a moving projection freezes a moving target.

p7.name: Metered Soft Joint
p7.definition: A meter cell per soft joint recording calls, latency, vector coverage, frozen hit rate, and drift; routing and the freeze frontier consult the meter. Call economics becomes a dimension of the sheet, visible and projectable like any other.
p7.unlocks: The operator sees cost/latency as a dimension and can throttle soft joints below frozen tables; 'punches above its weights' becomes a measurable curve per joint.
p7.grows_from: quilt-storefront budget-remaining + per-call usage receipting (67-c) + quilt-softjoints cache; delta: budget counters -> per-joint meter cells in the ledger.
p7.failure_mode: Metering overhead rivals the calls being metered; meters double-count under joint retries and cache hits, so the curve lies.

p8.name: Domain Skeleton Compiler
p8.definition: Feed raw domain traces (logs, transcripts, play-test runs) and get a proposed cell skeleton: deterministic lookup candidates, soft joints with vector labels, greeter candidates, and freeze candidates — a manifest a lane can accept or reject piecewise.
p8.unlocks: Composing a NEW domain onto the quilt starts from a compiled draft instead of an empty sheet; decomposition becomes a compiler output, not an art.
p8.grows_from: quilt-softjoints src/compiler.js (adjustment->cell) + quilt-lookup classification.json; delta: compiles CORRECTIONS to existing sheets -> compiles INITIAL skeletons for new domains.
p8.failure_mode: Greenfield proposals from thin traces freeze superstition; without the freezing test's evidence bar the compiler ships plausible-looking wrong tables.

p9.name: Freeze Frontier
p9.definition: A managed decision surface over the moment field: per region, frozen-table / dynamic-joint / greeter, updated ONLY when the freezing test passes on both fact and tone dimensions, with hysteresis so regions flicker between states. The frontier is displayed and controlled like any other projection.
p9.unlocks: The grind-down thesis becomes visible and governable: operators see WHERE the quilt is still alive and where it has become lookup, and control the budget dial accordingly.
p9.grows_from: quilt-softjoints freezingTest + quilt-storefront fallback-first frozen path (tryFrozen before backend); delta: per-joint binary freeze -> a region-map surface with hysteresis.
p9.failure_mode: A frontier that flips regions on thin evidence turns live judgment into stale tables mid-conversation; hysteresis parameters become new tuning hell.
